I am a water monger in the Worker's District.|Lortha Peel introduces himself|}} '''Lortha Peel''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[water monger]] that owned a water shop in the [[Worker's District]] of the [[city]] [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. After the ex-[[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] established himself as the new [[Daimyo]] of Tatooine, a [[Mods|street gang]] began stealing from Peel, prompting him to seek help from Fett. Explaining his situation to the Daimyo, he offered him extra tribute for getting rid of the gang. However, after learning that the street gang was unemployed and could not afford Peel's high [[water]] prices, Fett chose to employ them instead, forcing the water-monger to consider the situation resolved for a smaller payoff. ==Biography== {{Quote|Well, a street gang of insolent youths has been stealing my inventory. Now, this never happened under the other Daimyos and I am insulted on your behalf.|Lortha Peel explains his situation to Boba Fett|}} Lortha Peel worked as a [[water monger]], owning his own water shop in the [[Worker's District]] of the [[city]] [[Mos Espa]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He kept an inventory of [[water]] [[Moisture farm|harvested]] by [[moisture farmer]]s on Tatooine to and sold it at his shop. Around [[9 ABY]],{{BoBFDate}} the former [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|seized]] the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the late [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] and killed the Hutt's successor, [[Lord]] [[Bib Fortuna]],{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}} taking Fortuna's position as the new [[Daimyo]] of Tatooine.{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} With the new change in power came unrest within the streets of Mos Espa, many residents having no respect for Fett's leadership, especially after an [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|assassination attempt]] on the Daimyo took place in the city. A [[Mods|street gang]] of [[Cybernetics|cybernetically]] enhanced and unemployed youths began stealing from Peel's inventory, having been dissatisfied with the water-monger's high prices. [[File:Lorthas-petition.png|thumb|left|300px|Lortha Peel makes his petition to Boba Fett]] In hopes of getting rid of the street gang, Peel went to Fett's palace for help. After being allowed to enter the throne room, the water-monger introduced himself to Fett and began by explaining that no one respected the Daimyo and described the Mos Espa streets as being in chaos. He hesitated to mention the assassination attempt but did so anyway after Fett requested clarification. [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]] attempted to end the meeting, but Peel requested to continue his petition, being approved so by Fett. The water-monger described the street gang that was stealing from him and clarified about his job when Fett was curious for further details. Peel offered to double his tribute if Fett got rid of the gang. Fett went and confronted the street gang while they lingered near Peel's water shop. Learning of the water monger's high prices and the lack of work for the gang members, he chose to employ the youths himself. Hearing the exchange, Peel protested the decision, arguing that the gang had stolen from him. When the Daimyo asked what was owed to him, the water-monger claimed it was 1,300 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], although Fett was skeptical of the value since it was water that had been stolen. Thus the Daimyo chose to pay Peel 500 credits. Peel was dissatisfied by the incomplete payoff, but Fett threatened to end his business in Mos Espa if he did not considered the matter resolved. The water monger gave in to the demands, and the Daimyo told the man to cut the water prices before returning to his palace with the youths. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|They stole from me! And you're just going to let them off?|Peel protests to Fett|}} Lortha Peel was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, brown, graying [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s. He repeatedly claim that he was insulted on the Daimyo's behalf to imply that he shared the Daimyo's displeasure. When Fett decided to hire the street gang instead of getting rid of them, the water monger believed it was injustice. However, he conceded his protesting when faced by a threat from the Daimyo on his business in Mos Espa. ==Equipment== {{Quote|What do they owe you?''"
"''Thirteen hundred credits.''"
"''For water?''"
"''Thirteen hundred credits.|Fett and Peel|}} Peel wore beige and brown [[clothing]] with a satchel and brown [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:LorthaPeel-TBoBFPoster.png|thumb|right|200px|Lortha Peel character poster for ''The Book of Boba Fett''.]] Lortha Peel appeared in "[[Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa]]," the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[January 12]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} He was played by [[Stephen Root]]. The [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' mistakenly says Peel works in the Workers District of [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]] for the character's entry but correctly states he works in Mos Espa in the Tatooine entry for moisture farms. ==Appearances== *[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]] *{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-cargo-hold-chapter-3|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'' Cargo Hold: "Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa"}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Chrome Star Wars|cardname=#132 - Lortha Peel|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/376557163725}} *{{Databank|lortha-peel|Lortha Peel}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Lortha Peel |es=Lortha Peel |ja=ローサ・ピール |ka=ლორთა პილი |nl=Lortha Peel |pl=Lortha Peel |pt=Lortha Peel }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Peel, Lortha}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Merchants]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
